organizations.name: Amt für Migration Kanton Luzern
organizations.helps_with: Residence and work permits, family reunification, settlement permit C, visas, asylum and return. Send documents by post; use e-mail or phone for questions. Asylum phone line: 041 228 77 81.
organizations.hours: Counter and phone: Mon-Wed and Fri 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-17:00; Thu 14:00-17:00

organizations.name: Stadt Luzern Einwohnerdienste
organizations.helps_with: Residence registration when you move to the city of Lucerne. Register within 14 days. If you move from abroad, you must register in person at the counter. The registration fee is CHF 40.
what_to_bring: Foreigner identity card (Ausländerausweis), if you have one

organizations.name: RAV Kriens (Regionales Arbeitsvermittlungszentrum)
organizations.helps_with: Job placement for job seekers and unemployed people. Responsible for the city of Lucerne. Register online during your notice period, at the latest on the first day of unemployment.

organizations.name: Fabia Kompetenzzentrum Migration
organizations.helps_with: Free, confidential advice on migration and daily life in the canton of Lucerne: orientation for newcomers, integration offers and German courses, finances, social insurance, housing, children and family. Interpreters can join under some conditions. For people with permit B, C or L, and for refugees and permit F holders after 10 years in Switzerland. Walk-in consultation every Wednesday 15:00-16:30.

organizations.name: Fabia Deutschkurse
organizations.helps_with: German courses in Lucerne, with a placement test and registration.

organizations.name: Sozial Info REX (Stadt Luzern)
organizations.helps_with: Walk-in desk for social and health questions in the city of Lucerne. It points you to the right service and checks if you can get social assistance (Sozialhilfe). Register for social assistance in person, Mon-Fri 13:00-17:00. Writing help on Thursday 17:00-18:30.

organizations.name: Mieterinnen- und Mieterverband Luzern
organizations.helps_with: Tenancy law advice: rent, defects in the flat, moving out. Advice is free for members. Non-members get advice when they join: CHF 70 per calendar year plus CHF 20 one-time entry fee.
organizations.hours: Phone: Mon-Fri 09:00-12:30. Short advice without appointment: Tue and Thu 17:00-18:00

organizations.name: Volksschule Stadt Luzern (Rektorat)
organizations.helps_with: School registration for children of families who move to the city of Lucerne: kindergarten, primary and secondary school. Register with the online forms.

info.subject: health-insurance
info.summary: Everyone who lives in Switzerland must take out basic health insurance with a Swiss health insurer. You have 3 months after you move here. If you join in time, the insurance starts from the day you moved here.

info.subject: premium-reduction
info.summary: In the canton of Lucerne, WAS Ausgleichskasse Luzern can reduce your health insurance premiums. Apply each year, by 31 October of the year before. You cannot apply for past years. If you move here from abroad, you can have a claim during the year.

info.subject: public-transport
info.summary: Buy or validate your ticket before you travel: at a ticket machine, at a counter, from the bus driver or with a smartphone app (for example öV Plus or FAIRTIQ). Passepartout tickets are valid for train and bus in the zones you paid for.

info.subject: waste-disposal
info.summary: The collection dates for your street are in the official waste calendar of the city of Lucerne, as the Sammelkalender app or as a PDF. Only the waste calendar is binding. Waste phone: 041 208 78 70.

emergency.name: Opferhilfe Schweiz
emergency.description: Help for victims of violence or crime

emergency.name: Die Dargebotene Hand
emergency.description: Talk to someone about a crisis, anonymous and confidential. English: 0800 143 000, 18:00-23:00

emergency.name: Pro Juventute 147
emergency.description: Free, confidential advice for children and young people; the call does not show on the phone bill

emergency.name: Kantonale Gesundheitsleitstelle
emergency.description: Medical emergencies that are not life-threatening

emergency.name: Ärztetelefon
emergency.description: Doctor on call when your own doctor is not available
